scope: Preserve generated RGB with actual depth parallax in a Box Impostor

previousGeometryExperiments.summary: H and isolated I-head-local did not resolve the face; I-head-local was not merged into the full body or a new Box.

rootVisualAssessment.finding: The strong dark bands around eyes, below the nose and around the mouth decrease substantially; thin discontinuities, overlapping color around the brow, cheeks and chin, and hair noise remain. It does not exactly reproduce the registered +Z RGB.
rootVisualAssessment.status: Front visually improved, geometry accuracy not improved by this display-only change.

J.yawStatus: Seven real views from -45 to +45 degrees and a 13-view small-angle sequence completed; face color discontinuities persist.

K.status: Front, seven yaw views, and 13-view K-view small parallax sequence complete.
K.change: Only RGB view selection after native hit calculation
K.knownLimit: Angular blend can double inconsistent views at the 45-degree tie; dominant selection can pop. Visibility guard may fall back to native color.

metricMask.operator: Intersection of reference and every render alpha>250; three iterations of 3x3 binary erosion (Chebyshev radius 3), border=0.

K.rootFrontAssessment: The eyes, nose, mouth and hair closely reproduce the registered +Z RGB. Sparse opaque RGB residuals remain.
K.rootYawAssessment: Both K modes improve the face at +/-15 degrees and at +/-30 despite hair stripes. At +/-45, view produces mixing and dominant produces clear extra/doubled faces; the +45 side view has an extra face in the hair. Wide-angle appearance is unresolved.
K.loopRootReview: Examined the actual -15/0/+15 sequence frames and the seven-view board; K-view retains facial features while orientation and silhouette change.

cautions: An exact source-RGB comparison is an appearance metric, not ground-truth 3D accuracy.
Original 1024 RGB is a full-body image, not a 1024-pixel face crop.
All displayed comparison panels are actual renderings, with integer crops and nearest-neighbor enlargement; no AI image retouching.
